intro_text: Delivering sustainable, year-round aid through our education programmes.

programmes.title: Light A Dream Scholarship (LADS)
programmes.description: Providing financial assistance, annual scholarship camps, and educational mentorship to bright, underprivileged Cambodian students to empower them to pursue higher education.

programmes.title: School Support Programme
programmes.description: Creating conducive learning environments through teacher training, physical, emotional and psychological health curriculum, and providing essential resources such as administrative laptops and sports equipment.

programmes.title: Post-Screening Health Education
programmes.description: Delivering interactive village and student workshops on hypertension, diabetes prevention, first aid skills, soap-making, and dental hygiene.
